name: cod
description: A local desktop workspace for coding agents and reviews

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/workspace-shell.spec.ts tests/e2e/native-chat.spec.ts tests/e2e/terminals.spec.ts tests/e2e/runtime-context.spec.ts tests/e2e/browser.spec.ts tests/e2e/browser-diagnostics.spec.ts tests/e2e/browser-recovery.spec.ts tests/e2e/extension-upgrade.spec.ts tests/e2e/files.spec.ts tests/e2e/reviews.spec.ts tests/e2e/browser-addons.spec.ts tests/e2e/design-journeys.spec.ts tests/e2e/registered-page.spec.ts tests/e2e/attention-status.spec.ts tests/e2e/ui-interactions.spec.ts tests/e2e/navigation-settings.spec.ts tests/e2e/workflow-integrity.spec.ts tests/e2e/keyboard-journeys.spec.ts
scripts.test:chat: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/native-chat.spec.ts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:terminals: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/terminals.spec.ts
scripts.test:runtime: npm run build && node --test tests/runtime-integration/cli-protocol.test.mjs && playwright test tests/e2e/runtime-context.spec.ts
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/browser.spec.ts
scripts.test:reviews: npm run build && node --test tests/reviews/service.test.ts && playwright test tests/e2e/reviews.spec.ts
scripts.test:files: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/files.spec.ts
